items.title: Betty Lee Hanson, Joe James, George Lewis, Joe Lewis, Joe Butler, Kid Thomas Valentine, Bill Russell, Allan…
items.q: we got together with the little band... we just rehearsed. We rehearsed three or four times a week.

ctx.x: No kidding, he died like that?

He died right there. So, this boy, his brother-in-law told him, he said, I know a fella you might get to play with you. He said, live out there in the country. He said, why don't you write to him? So, he write, he written to me, but I was already down here already, see? So, I went on over there, and LJ is on the other side. I went over there, so, we got together with the little band. And, well, then, fellas, you know, they was already playing. See, they had the band, it was just the trumpet player they needed,…
Well, weren't you terribly tired? How'd you get any rest?
